title: Nightlace and the Fraction of Silk
story: Nightlace the Cellar Weaver has webbed shut the town's water cistern, and the web only dissolves when cut in the right amounts. Cut too little and it re-knits; cut too much and the ceiling comes down. Mr 6 studies the shimmering strands and starts figuring in fractions.
question: The web is 3/5 silk and 2/5 dust. Mr 6 must cut away 1/4 of the silk part. If the whole web weighs 60 kilograms, how many kilograms must he cut?
hint: Find the silk part of the 60 kilograms first, then take one quarter of just that.
victory: Exactly nine kilograms of silk drifted away and the whole web unravelled like a dropped sweater; Nightlace applauded with all eight legs and moved to the barn.
imagePrompt: A shimmering grey spider the size of a pony perched on a vast silver web sealing a stone cistern, a numeral-six knight measuring strands by lantern light in a damp cellar.
